name: sim_hand_back_at_window_start
description: A returning seat is handed back exactly when the next build window opens (design 6.7, M4): the Lookout goes AWAY in wave 2 and the server's BACK comes a few turns later. From BACK to the window every order of hers is refused with the contract's CARETAKEN ('The caretaker hands back at the next build window') while the caretaker keeps playing the seat; the stage that clears the wave makes her present, so the first turn at or after the window's first tick is hers (an order on the road is refused for what it is, CANNOT_BUILD_THERE), the caretaker no longer acts for her even at the window's start, when it would have, and the window waits for her Ready.

steps.msg: BACK in the wave: the seat is returning, the caretaker still holds it
(the window opens on a turn's tick, so the order of that very turn shows who holds the seat at the window's first tick)

steps.assert: moves.size() == 3 and moves[0][1] == 'away' and moves[1][1] == 'returning' and moves[2] == [window - 1, 'present']
steps.msg: away, returning, then present in the stage that opened the window: from its first tick the seat is hers
both clients hand back at the same tick

steps.assert: caretaken >= 20 and refused[caretaken - 1][0] < window and refused[caretaken - 1][1] == 'CARETAKEN'
steps.msg: every order until the window was refused with CARETAKEN
the first turn at or after the window's first tick is the player's: her order is judged for what it is
the caretaker built or forked for her while it held the seat
and nothing from the window on, not even at its start
and the window waits for her Ready
